about: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data, St. Louis Fed): search economic time series and read their metadata and latest observations, and browse categories, tags, releases, release tables, the release calendar and data sources.

commands.summary: Search FRED series by keyword (the header autocomplete); returns series IDs, titles, frequency, units and date coverage

params.name: q
params.description: Search keywords, e.g. 'gdp', 'unemployment rate'

commands.summary: Get chart metadata for a series by ID: title, frequency, observation date range, units, seasonal adjustment and available transformations

params.name: id
params.description: FRED series ID, e.g. GDPC1, UNRATE, CPIAUCSL

commands.summary: Get the most recent observations (date and value) shown on a series page

params.name: id
params.description: FRED series ID, e.g. GDPC1

commands.summary: List the top-level FRED data categories and their main subcategories, with category IDs (in the url) and series counts
List series in a category (by category ID), with optional tag filter, sorting and paging

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric category ID (from list-categories urls), e.g. 32447 = Unemployment Rate

params.name: t
params.description: Tag(s) to filter by, using tag slugs (e.g. 'females'); separate multiple tags with ';'

params.name: ob
params.description: Sort key: 'pv' = popularity, 'lu' = last updated (the UI offers a few more)

params.name: od
params.description: Sort direction

params.name: pageID
params.description: Results page number, starting at 1

commands.summary: List all series or series matching tags (e.g. 'inflation'), sorted by popularity or last update; with no tag and ob=pv this lists the most popular series

params.name: t
params.description: Tag slug(s), e.g. 'inflation', 'usa', 'nsa'; separate multiple tags with ';'. Leave empty for all series

params.name: ob
params.description: Sort key: 'pv' = popularity, 'lu' = last updated

params.name: od
params.description: Sort direction

params.name: pageID
params.description: Results page number, starting at 1

commands.summary: List or search FRED tags (concepts, geographies, frequencies, sources, ...) with series counts; tag slugs feed list-series-by-tag

params.name: st
params.description: Tag search text, e.g. 'inflation'. Empty lists all tags

params.name: tg
params.description: Tag group: all, gen (concepts), geo (geographies), geot (geography types), freq (frequencies), seas (seasonal adjustment), rls (releases), src (sources)

params.name: pageID
params.description: Results page number (50 tags per page)

commands.summary: List FRED data releases alphabetically (50 per page) with release IDs (rid in the url)

params.name: pageID
params.description: Page number, starting at 1

commands.summary: List series in a data release (by release ID), with optional tag filter, sorting and paging

params.name: rid
params.description: Release ID, e.g. 194 = ADP National Employment Report, 53 = GDP, 50 = Employment Situation

params.name: t
params.description: Tag slug(s) to filter by; separate multiple tags with ';'

params.name: ob
params.description: Sort key: 'pv' = popularity, 'lu' = last updated

params.name: od
params.description: Sort direction

params.name: pageID
params.description: Results page number, starting at 1

commands.summary: Browse a release's table tree: list the table sections/elements under a release (or under a given element ID) with element IDs (eid in the url) and series counts

params.name: rid
params.description: Release ID, e.g. 194

params.name: eid
params.description: Release table element ID to drill into, e.g. 1232736 (from the release page or a previous call)

commands.summary: Get the release calendar for a date range (all releases or one release ID) as per-day events, e.g. '33 releases' on 2026-10-19

params.name: vs
params.description: Start date of the view, ISO date (a Sunday for week view), e.g. 2026-10-18. Defaults to the current week

params.name: ve
params.description: End date of the view, ISO date, e.g. 2026-10-24

params.name: rid
params.description: Restrict to one release ID (empty = all releases)

commands.summary: List the data sources (agencies and organizations) that FRED series come from, with source IDs (soid in the url)

params.name: pageID
params.description: Page number, starting at 1

commands.summary: List the releases published by a data source (by source ID)

params.name: soid
params.description: Source ID, e.g. 42 = Automatic Data Processing, Inc.
